ālaya.cp: masc. 1. abode; roosting place; 2. desire; attachment; 3. pretence.
ālaya.p: [Ā+laya+a] (pu,na) CL=7 [Dhāna,ṭī. 163. Ā+lī+a. Rū,nhā-351] (1) (A) The dhamma which should be associated. Sensuality, Lust. (C) Two kinds of Ālaya which are lust , wrong belief. (D) The dhamma which dwells the attachment of sensual pleasures again and again by Lust, Upādāna five aggregates embodying a being. See - Ālayarāma-(C). (E) Desire. (2) Nature of things (or) State of affairs, Nature of things which want to preach. (3) Deception, gesture/Style, expression. (4) The place (or) Location, place of dependance/lean, Place, (Home, Monastery, dwelling place (or) Nest etc.,). (Upādāna means attachment (or) clinging to existence (or) obsession).

ālayarāma.p: [Ālaya+ramu+ṇa] (ti) CL=7 (A) Pleasure with the five aggregates of sensuality. (B) Clinging to the five aggregates of sensuality, pleasure in passion/lust. (C)     Pleasure on Upādāna five aggregates embodying a being that is the dhamma which dwells the attachment of sensual pleasures again and again with Lust.

（က） ငြိကပ်-မှီဝဲ-အပ်သော ကာမဂုဏ်ငါးပါးဟူသော （ဝဋ်ဒုက္ခဟူသော） မွေ့လျော်ရာရှိသော။ （ခ） ငြိကပ်-မှီဝဲ-တတ်သော တဏှာတို့ဖြင့် မွေ့လျော်သော။ အာလယရာမ-လည်းကြည့်။
R:
ālayarāma：အာလယ-ရာမ（ပ）
ကာမဂုဏ်ငါးပါး၌ မွေ့လျော်ခြင်း။

ālayārāma：အာလယာရာမ（ပ） （အာလယ+အာရာမ）
သင်္ခါရတရားတို့၌ တည်နေရာအဖြစ်ဖြင့် နှလုံးသွင်းခြင်း။
